titleStmt.title: speech of dr. francisco león de la barra, envoy extraordinary and minister plenipotentiary from the united states of mexico to the kingdom of belgium, delegate from mexico.

head.hi: speech of dr. francisco león de la barra, envoy extraordinary and minister plenipotentiary from the united states of mexico to the kingdom of belgium, delegate from mexico.

div.p: Mr. President, Honorable Ministers, and Honorable Delegates:
The delegation from Mexico has the honor of seconding the motion just presented by the honorable delegate from Perú.

The visit of the Secretary of State of the United States has for us a very special significance. The eminent coworker of the illustrious President Roosevelt, as we have just heard in the beautiful address we have enthusiastically applauded, brings us the good wishes of the First Magistrate of his country for the success of the labors of this conference; and they will bear fruit, because they are based on mutual respect for the rights of States.
With these considerations the delegation from Mexico, in accordance with the proposal made by the delegates from Perú, respectfully asks the conference to carry it by acclamation.

note.p: The motion was carried by acclamation.
